description: issue #689: the parenthesized form `(set_tempo 1 2)` supplies two inputs to an arity-1 Sound primitive. With the `sound` profile active the Layer-2 checker (checker-arity.ts) flags `ol-too-many-inputs` at the callee span - the paren form is the reader's escape hatch, so its arity is a checker concern (spec/tooling.md:175-176), not a parse error.
